summary: GraphRAG has become a catch-all term for graph-enhanced retrieval, Text2Cypher, agent memory and community-based summarization, which creates confusion about what "use GraphRAG" actually means. This keynote gives AI engineers a practical map of the landscape. It starts from the limits of vector-only RAG on data that is connected, multi-hop, dynamic or needs to be explainable, then breaks GraphRAG into building blocks: constructing knowledge graphs from structured and unstructured data, choosing among lexical, domain and meta graphs, and applying retrieval patterns. GraphRAG is treated as a toolbox with clear trade-offs, not one recipe, with evaluation, governance and production readiness in view from the start.
